Compatible VW, Audi, Seat and Škoda models

Check which diagnostic protocol your Volkswagen, Audi, Seat, Škoda or Cupra uses (TP 2.0, 11-bit UDS or 29-bit UDS), whether SFD write protection applies, and which Bluetooth ELM327 adapter to use.

ModelYearsPlatformProtocolSFD / Status
